comparison.root_cause_disclosure: Commit b4174fe initialized the SFT checkpoint directory by copying the adapter from the RL checkpoint directory. Consequently, on-disk adapter_model.safetensors files are byte-for-byte duplicate copies sharing identical weights.
comparison.scientific_interpretation: Evaluations under SFT Pass A and RL Pass B represent stochastic evaluation passes (T=0.7, top_p=0.8) over the locked 50 dev worlds under a single shared adapter checkpoint. They are not an SFT vs. RL post-training causal ablation.
